about: One-off dealing charges of open-ended funds dealt with their manager (Chip and Prosper FUND lines, via Seccl): entry/exit charge from each share class's KIID, dilution policy from the manager's prospectus. entry/exit are fractions (0 = 'None'/'0.00%'/'Not applicable'); null = only a maximum is stated (entryMax). dilution.kind: swing = single swinging price, the adjustment is in the dealt price, nothing added; mmf = money market fund, liquidity fee only under the money market fund regulation's stress triggers, nothing added; levy with rate = stated levy rate; levy with freeBelowGbp = no levy below that deal size, unknown above; duties = Duties and Charges added to the subscription / deducted from the redemption price at the manager's discretion, no published rate; unknown = mechanism not stated. excessiveTradingMax: the KIID allows a charge up to that rate when the manager suspects excessive trading (Janus: subscriptions held under 90 days); it is a penalty at the manager's discretion, not a dealing charge, so it is noted, not added.

vanguard.name: Vanguard (Vanguard Investments UK / Vanguard Group (Ireland))
vanguard.quote: Since May 2019, Vanguard has employed partial swing pricing. This means that we adjust the price for all transactions in a fund on a given day [...] (full swing 2017-2019 'for its UK and Ireland-domiciled funds'). KIIDs: 'Entry charge None', 'Exit charge None'.

blackrock-bcif.name: BlackRock Collective Investment Funds (iShares index funds (UK))
blackrock-bcif.quote: Each Fund is a single priced fund [...] Each Fund operates a single swing pricing methodology where the price of each unit may be adjusted [...] (known as a 'dilution adjustment').
blackrock-bcif.excessiveTrading: KIID: 'Subject to a charge of up to 2% paid into the Fund where the Manager suspects excessive trading by an investor.'

blackrock-retail.name: BlackRock Retail Authorised Unit Trusts (BlackRock Emerging Markets Fund)
blackrock-retail.quote: Each Single-Priced Fund operates a single swing pricing methodology [...] The Single-Priced Funds began to use single pricing and the single swing pricing methodology with effect from 15 June 2026. Swing table: Blackrock Emerging Markets Fund 0.11 to 0.20 (offer) 0.19 to 0.28 (bid).
blackrock-retail.excessiveTrading: KIID: 'Subject to a charge of up to 2% paid into the Fund where the Manager suspects excessive trading by an investor.'

blackrock-bif.name: BlackRock Investment Funds (MyMap)
blackrock-bif.quote: Each Single-Priced Fund operates a single swing pricing methodology [...] Swing table lists MyMap 3/4/5/6/8 (e.g. MyMap 6 Fund 0.01 / 0.01).
blackrock-bif.excessiveTrading: KIID: 'Subject to a charge of up to 2% paid into the Fund where the Manager suspects excessive trading by an investor.'

blackrock-bgf.name: BlackRock Global Funds (Luxembourg)
blackrock-bgf.quote: 17.3 The Directors may adjust the Net Asset Value per Share for a Fund [...] by an amount not exceeding 1.50%, or 3% in the case of fixed income Funds. Class D KIIDs: 'Entry Charge 5.00%' (maximum; 'In some cases you might pay less').
blackrock-bgf.excessiveTrading: KIID: 'Subject to a charge of up to 2% paid into the Fund where the Manager suspects excessive trading by an investor.'

blackrock-bisf.name: BlackRock Index Selection Fund (iShares index funds (IE))
blackrock-bisf.quote: Subscription Price: the Net Asset Value [...] adding thereto such sum as the Manager may consider represents an appropriate figure for Duties and Charges [...] The Manager may levy Duties and Charges [...] The level of Duties and Charges is determined by the Manager. No rate is published.

blackrock-bfidf.name: BlackRock Fixed Income Dublin Funds plc (iShares GiltTrak / UK Credit Bond Index Fund (IE))
blackrock-bfidf.quote: subscription price per Share [...] Net Asset Value [...] adding thereto such sum as the Directors may consider represents an appropriate figure for Duties and Charges. No rate is published.

blackrock-ics.name: BlackRock Institutional Cash Series plc (Sterling Liquidity, LVNAV money market fund)
blackrock-ics.quote: Save as described below, no preliminary charge is payable in respect of the Shares, nor are any redemption fees payable [...] It is not currently intended to charge any such fees. Liquidity fees only if weekly maturing assets fall below 30% (and net redemptions exceed 10%) or below 10%. 'Non-MMF Funds may [...] apply anti-dilution mechanisms.'

hsbc-itif.name: HSBC Index Tracker Investment Funds
hsbc-itif.quote: The Company deals on the basis of 'single pricing' [...] the ACD may make an Initial Charge on Shares purchased (such charge is currently 0%) [...] For both purchases and sales, a dilution adjustment may be made to the price of a Share. Estimated rates: FTSE All-World Index Fund 0.12 - 0.14, American Index Fund 0.07.

hsbc-openfunds.name: HSBC OpenFunds (Global Strategy portfolios)
hsbc-openfunds.quote: The Company deals on the basis of 'single pricing' [...] For both purchases and sales, a dilution adjustment may be made to the price of a Share.

hsbc-islamic.name: HSBC Islamic Funds (Luxembourg)
hsbc-islamic.quote: There are two anti-dilution mechanisms available to each sub-fund, a pricing adjustment and an anti-dilution levy [...] Details of which anti-dilution mechanism is in operation on a particular sub-fund can be obtained from the Management Company. KIID: 'Entry charge 3.00%' (maximum).

lg.name: Legal & General (Unit Trust Managers)
lg.quote: Single Swing: the pricing methodology [...] where the Net Asset Value per Unit may be adjusted on any Dealing Day by way of a Dilution Adjustment. KIID: 'Dilution adjustment: on any day, the prices for buying or selling units in this Fund are the same.'

fidelity-fif.name: Fidelity Investment Funds (Fidelity Index funds)
fidelity-fif.quote: Shares are priced on a single, mid-market basis [...] Price Adjustment Policy (Swing Pricing) [...] the ACD may require the payment of a dilution levy on the first day of dealing only in these Funds and thereafter the Price Adjustment Policy (Swing Pricing) as set out above will apply.

fidelity-fifiv.name: Fidelity Investment Funds IV (Multi Asset Allocator)
fidelity-fifiv.quote: the ACD has the power to charge a dilution levy when Shares are bought or sold [...] The ACD will not impose a dilution levy in respect of any deal (or series of deals placed on the same day) involving shares with a value below £500,000. Appendix 9: no swing or levy applied to the Multi Asset Allocator funds over three years (N/A).

fidelity-ff.name: Fidelity Funds (Luxembourg SICAV)
fidelity-ff.quote: Swing Pricing: The Board or Management Company may apply swing pricing by adjusting the NAV of the relevant fund using a swing factor [...] Swing Pricing may increase the subscription price or reduce the redemption proceeds.

abrdn.name: abrdn OEIC I
abrdn.quote: The Company has a single swinging price. The single price can be swung up or down in response to inflows or outflows from the Company.

artemis.name: Artemis Investment Funds ICVC
artemis.quote: the Regulations allow the ACD to adjust the sale and purchase price of Shares [...] This is known as making a dilution adjustment or operating swinging single pricing. There is only a single price for each Class of Share.

aviva-lux.name: Aviva Investors Luxembourg SICAV
aviva-lux.quote: The Sub-Funds are single priced [...] the Management Company will apply 'swing pricing' as part of its daily valuation policy [...] (not exceeding 2% of that NAV).

aviva-liquidity.name: Aviva Investors Liquidity Funds plc (Sterling Liquidity Fund, LVNAV money market fund)
aviva-liquidity.quote: Preliminary Charge: No preliminary charge will be payable on the issue of Shares in the Sub-Fund. Exchange Charge None. Redemption Charge None. Liquidity fees (anti-dilution levy) only if weekly maturing assets fall below 30% with net daily redemptions above 10%, or below 10%.

axa.name: AXA Framlington authorised unit trusts
axa.quote: Each Fund is a single priced scheme [...] the Manager applies a dilution adjustment in the calculation of the Price, a policy known as 'swing pricing'.

franklin-uk.name: Franklin Templeton Funds (UK OEIC)
franklin-uk.quote: Shares will be 'single priced' with the same price for buying or selling on any particular day [...] recovered from investors [...] by means of a dilution adjustment to the dealing price [...] The ACD shall comply with COLL 6.3.8R.

franklin-lux.name: Franklin Templeton Shariah Funds (Luxembourg)
franklin-lux.quote: The Fund operates a swing pricing mechanism which may be applied when the total capital activity [...] exceeds a pre-determined threshold. KIID: 'Entry charge Not applicable*' (*share class only available through certain financial advisers which may apply their own charges).

fundsmith.name: Fundsmith Equity Fund (UK OEIC)
fundsmith.quote: The ACD has decided that its policy on dilution is that it will make a dilution adjustment to the price of Shares [...] will not normally be applied unless the net creations or redemptions exceed 5% of the value of the Company [...] ordinarily of the magnitude of +/- 0.15%.

janus.name: Janus Henderson (UK OEIC)
janus.quote: the ACD has discretion to make a dilution adjustment in the calculation of the dealing price and thereby swing the dealing price of shares.
janus.excessiveTrading: KIID: '** Subject to a charge of up to 3.00% where the Manager suspects excessive trading by an investor (and specifically on subscriptions held for less than 90 days).'

jpm.name: JPMorgan Fund ICVC
jpm.quote: (assets - liabilities) +/- any dilution adjustment = NAV [...] a Fund's NAV may be adjusted [...] normally applied on any Dealing Day when net purchases or net redemptions of Shares in a Fund exceed 1.00% of Fund assets. JPM Global Research Enhanced Index Equity Fund 0.08 / 0.11; JPM US Research Enhanced Index Equity Fund 0.02 / 0.02.

liontrust.name: Liontrust (UK OEIC)
liontrust.quote: The price per Share at which Shares are bought, redeemed or switched is the Net Asset Value per Share (as adjusted [...] by any dilution adjustment) [...] any dilution adjustment will in percentage terms affect the price of Shares of each Class identically. Liontrust Global Technology Fund: 11 offer adjustments averaging 0.10% in 2024.

mg.name: M&G Securities (M&G OEICs)
mg.quote: it is the ACD's policy to apply a dilution adjustment to the net asset value in certain circumstances [...] by means of a dilution adjustment to the net asset value to arrive at the Share price (M&G Investment Funds (1); M&G Global Dividend Fund sits in another M&G OEIC under the same ACD policy).

royal-london.name: Royal London Bond Funds ICVC (Short-Term Money Market Fund)
royal-london.quote: Dilution Levy (applicable to Royal London Short-Term Money Market Fund) [...] the ACD does not generally expect to impose a dilution levy [...] Royal London Short-Term Money Market Fund 0 N/A 0.00% (current dilution levy rate expected to be applied).

schroders.name: Schroder Unit Trusts Limited
schroders.quote: All Funds listed in this prospectus are single priced [...] may be subject to the imposition of a dilution adjustment after which the price to be applied is known as the 'dealing price'.
